narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -7.06 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 5.488-5.518 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 5.546; the first objective pays 1.48R at 5.465.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 5.488-5.518
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 5.546 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 1.48 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Neutral equilibrium 50/100 — trend broken, flow confirming
